properties.name: Thickness
properties.description: Wall thickness. 0 builds the air space as a solid body instead of a hollow shell

properties.name: BoxLength
properties.description: Casing length. 0: automatic, twice the largest duct size, made larger where a duct would not fit on its face

properties.name: BoxWidth
properties.description: Casing width. 0: automatic, twice the largest duct size, made larger where a duct would not fit on its face

properties.name: BoxHeight
properties.description: Casing height. 0: automatic, twice the largest duct size, made larger where a duct would not fit on its face

properties.name: CentreOffsetX
properties.description: Moves the box from the node along its length

properties.name: CentreOffsetY
properties.description: Moves the box from the node along its width

properties.name: CentreOffsetZ
properties.description: Moves the box from the node along its height

properties.name: TrimLength
properties.description: Collar length of each port, beyond the box face. 0 uses a quarter of that duct's size
